newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PM Kok to meet Britain's Blair on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PM Kok to meet Britain's Blair on Friday.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok will travel to London on Friday for talks with his newly-elected British counterpart Tony Blair, the Dutch government said on Monday.
A spokeswoman for Kok's office said the meeting was at Blair's invitation and would be held "within the context of the Dutch presidency of the European Union".
She added that Kok would be accompanied by Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo and the talks would also include the new British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook.
Media reports said talks would focus on EU matters ahead of a key summit to be held in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17.
Kok congratulated Blair last Friday on the Labour Party's landslide win in the British general election and said he hoped the new government would be cooperative on European issues.

The Dutch have also scheduled an informal meeting of EU leaders in Noordwijk on May 23. Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo said on Friday the extra meeting would give member states the chance to quiz Blair on his stance towards deeper EU integration.
